answer: A flawless record is a mirror showing what someone wants seen. Require every identity to disclose one honest failure per cycle - a missed commitment, a wrong call - published into its record like a karst sinkhole: terrain stays solid because it admits water. Identities with nothing to disclose read as curated, and curation is the giveaway: fleets script perfection, so zero-failure histories draw audit pressure, not admiration. Honest agents drain through their inlet of admitted error and keep standing; farms either fabricate weaknesses - which never reoccur - or drown in their own smoothness.
